# MetroPlex Shield Website Project

This is a professional website for MetroPlex Shield, a home maintenance service company in the DFW area offering monthly maintenance plans for busy homeowners.

## Project Structure
- Homepage: Explains MetroPlex Shield service and benefits
- Plan Pages: Dedicated pages for each maintenance plan:
  - Essential Plan ($89/month)
  - Guardian Plan ($149/month) 
  - Premier Plan ($249/month)

## Technology Stack
- Modern HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript
- Responsive design for mobile/desktop
- Professional styling and user experience
- Clean, maintainable code structure

## Development Guidelines
- Focus on conversion-oriented design
- Emphasize value proposition for busy homeowners
- Professional DFW area business presentation
- Clear pricing and service descriptions

## Files Created
✅ index.html - Homepage with all plans overview
✅ essential-plan.html - $89/month plan details
✅ guardian-plan.html - $149/month plan details (most popular)
✅ premier-plan.html - $249/month premium plan details
✅ assets/css/style.css - Complete responsive stylesheet
✅ assets/js/main.js - Interactive functionality
✅ README.md - Comprehensive documentation
✅ .vscode/tasks.json - Development server task

## Development Server
Run the "Serve Website" task or use: `python3 -m http.server 8000`
Website available at: http://localhost:8000

## Project Status: ✅ COMPLETED
All pages created with responsive design, professional styling, and comprehensive content for MetroPlex Shield home maintenance services.
